name: LRT-0 residue — remove AGENT_DONE_WORD agent loop and dead sub-task generation
description:
## Context
Milestone LRT-0 (preparation for long-running tasks, design in `docs/long-running-tasks.md` §10) is reported as done, but the repository still contains the residue LRT-1 depends on being gone. Verified by direct file reads:
- `codx/junior/globals.py` still defines `AGENT_DONE_WORD = "$$@@AGENT_DONE@@$$$"`.
- `codx/junior/chat/chat_engine.py` still has the `is_agent_done = AGENT_DONE_WORD in response_message.content` branch, the recursive `chat_with_project(... iteration + 1)` call, `if is_agent: tags.append("agent")` and the `is_agent` refine prompt asking the model to "Return { AGENT_DONE_WORD }".
- `codx/junior/engine/chat_engine_actions.py` still implements `generate_tasks` (+ `SubTaskStatus` / `TaskGenerationStatus`), `codx/junior/sio/sio.py` still registers `codx-junior-subtasks`, `app.py` still has `@app.post("/api/chats/sub-tasks")` calling `codx_junior_session.generate_tasks`.
- `codx/junior/app.py` keeps legacy duplicated handlers (two `@app.on_event("startup")`, legacy `/api/chats` and `/api/kanban` duplicating `codx/junior/api/chat.py`), and `api/chat.py` defines mark-seen twice.

## Objective
Remove the deprecated agent-iteration machinery and the dead sub-task generation, then de-duplicate the startup hook and the routes — so the engine has exactly one way to drive a chat before the long-running runner is added.

## Steps
1. **Agent logic.** Delete `AGENT_DONE_WORD` from `codx/junior/globals.py` and every reference: `chat_engine.py` (`is_agent_done`, the `if is_agent and not is_agent_done and iterations_left` recursion, the `"agent"` tag in `_build_ai_headers`, the `is_agent` refine prompt block), `chat_prompt_builder.append_agent_message`, `build_ai_prompt_messages(is_agent=...)`, `_resolve_chat_mode_flags` `is_agent`, the `CHAT_MODE_AGENT` constant and the `get_agent_max_iterations` usage. A chat with `mode="agent"` must behave like a normal chat and can no longer loop on itself.
2. **Dead sub-task generation.** Remove `ChatEngineActions.generate_tasks` (and `SubTaskStatus` / `TaskGenerationStatus` when nothing else uses them), `CODXJuniorSession.generate_tasks`, the sio handler `codx-junior-subtasks`, and the `/api/chats/sub-tasks` handlers. The route may survive as a single `410 Gone` stub, but nothing may call a removed method.
3. **De-duplicate.** One `@app.on_event("startup")` in `app.py` (keep the one that really initialises socket/session and `start_background_services`), one `PUT /chats/mark-seen/{chat_id}/{message_id}` in `api/chat.py`, and no handler defined in both `app.py` and `api/chat.py` (`codx/junior/api` is auto-discovered by `discover_routers` — keep that one).

## Acceptance criteria
- `grep -rn "AGENT_DONE_WORD" codx/` returns nothing.
- `grep -rn "generate_tasks" codx/` returns only comments/docstrings — no call site, no sio handler.
- `python -c "import codx.junior.chat.chat_engine, codx.junior.engine.session, codx.junior.api.chat, codx.junior.sio.sio"` succeeds.
- One startup hook and one mark-seen route remain (paste the `grep -c` output in the task).
- A `mode="agent"` chat answers once, exactly like `mode="chat"`.

## Out of scope
The long-running feature itself (LRT-1), kanban storage v2, `root_id`, cost roll-up — already in place.

## Files
codx/junior/globals.py · codx/junior/chat/chat_engine.py · codx/junior/chat/chat_prompt_builder.py · codx/junior/engine/chat_engine_actions.py · codx/junior/engine/session.py · codx/junior/engine.py · codx/junior/sio/sio.py · codx/junior/api/chat.py · codx/junior/app.py · docs/long-running-tasks.md (mark 0.5/0.6 done)
